title: Importer Test
eyebrow: Ready for you to test · pull request "Import notes from Keep, Samsung Notes, Apple Notes, Google Docs and Word"

unverified: No real Google Takeout, Samsung Notes or Apple Notes export has been imported; Keep's field names come from open-source converters, so your first real Takeout is the true test
Dragging files onto the Notes tab is built but was not tried in a browser; only the file-picker button was

The browser checks of the Overview screen and of offline use last ran before the final small fix. That fix changed only the archived badge, Keep's Labels.txt file, and the code that reads your notes and draws the notes card
Nothing has run on your phone; all browser checks ran in Chromium in a cloud machine

short.lead: The importer is built: a Notes tab on the Sort screen reads your exported notes in the browser and keeps them on that device, ready for triage. It passed 221 code tests and 67 browser checks. What it has not met yet is a real export of yours.
short.hint: Tap a step for exactly what to do and what you should see.
items: 221 code tests pass, run twice. The browser check passes 67 of 67, run twice. It imports 206 sample notes (134 Keep, 48 text and Markdown, 24 Word) at phone and desktop width. Importing again adds nothing, an edited note updates, 10 archived badges show, and an import works with the network off.
Nothing to do here; I already ran these checks.

items.caption: The Notes tab at phone width, from the browser check.

items: The importer goes live on https://ajw2003.github.io/Unblocked/app/ once the deploy finishes, in a minute or two.
On GitHub, open the pull request "Import notes from Keep, Samsung Notes, Apple Notes, Google Docs and Word" (https://github.com/Ajw2003/Unblocked/pull/20) and press Merge.

In Samsung Notes, long-press a note, tick a few more notes, then choose Save as file and pick Word or Text. Then open Unblock, go to Sort, open the Notes tab, choose those files, check the preview, and press Import.
You should see each note's title and text, and checklists as items. Tell me any note that came through wrong.
Import a Google Keep Takeout (if you use Keep)
At takeout.google.com, deselect all, tick only Keep, and export. Drop the zip on the Notes tab.
Checklist ticks, labels and archived notes should come through; trashed notes are skipped. This is the real test of Keep's format.
If everything came through right, testing is finished. If anything came through wrong, I start a fix.
Tap Copy my reply to send "QA passed: Importer", or tell me what came through wrong.

wrapup.summary: The importer is built and checked on sample files, and waits for a test with your real exports.
wrapup.changing: A Notes tab on the Sort screen, an on-device Notes library, and a notes count on the Overview.
wrapup.blocking: Your test with real Samsung Notes files, and a Keep Takeout if you use Keep.
wrapup.next: Any note that comes through wrong becomes a fix with a test built from it; once you pass it, the next step is building triage (issue #14), which turns your imported notes into tasks.
